headline: Sharpen focus & memory
blurb: A pulsing tone used in Alzheimer's, attention, and mood research. Listen while you work or read.
label: 40 Hz gamma — cognition & attention

citations.title: Gamma sensory stimulation in mild Alzheimer's dementia (GENUS)
40-Hz binaural beats enhance training to mitigate the attentional blink

notes: MIT GENUS protocol: 1 hr/day. AM-modulated tone because raw 40 Hz is barely audible. Small pilot trials also report mood/depression benefits from 40 Hz sensory stimulation.

headline: Quiet your tinnitus
blurb: Pink noise with a notch removed at your tinnitus pitch. Calibrate once, then listen long-term.
label: Tinnitus notched pink noise

citations.title: Listening to tailor-made notched music reduces tinnitus loudness
Muenster tinnitus RCT: tailor-made notched music training

notes: Requires calibrating your tinnitus pitch. Studies show 2+ hr/day over 3+ months. Tinnitus pitch must be <= 8000 Hz.

headline: Fall into deeper sleep
blurb: A slow binaural pulse used in sleep studies. Play it as you wind down — headphones on.
label: 3 Hz delta — sleep support

citations.title: Auditory stimulation using delta binaural beat for better sleep and mood
A Novel Insight of Effects of a 3-Hz Binaural Beat on Sleep Stages During Sleep
Binaural beats at 0.25 Hz shorten the latency to slow-wave sleep during daytime naps

notes: Pilot-level evidence. 90 min pre-sleep. Requires headphones.

headline: Calm down & unwind
blurb: A gentle binaural pulse linked to meditation and anxiety reduction. Headphones on.
label: 6 Hz theta — relaxation

citations.title: Brain Responses to a 6-Hz Binaural Beat
Effects of daily listening to 6 Hz binaural beats over one month: an event-related potentials study
Auditory driving of the autonomic nervous system: theta-frequency binaural beats post-exercise

notes: 20-30 min. Requires headphones. Stronger evidence when combined with ambient music.

headline: Relax & lift mood
blurb: A binaural pulse studied for mood support and relaxation. Play it during a quiet break.
label: 10 Hz alpha — relaxation / mood

citations.title: Receptive Music Therapy with Imbedded 10 Hz Binaural Beats for MDD: RCT
Binaural beats for perioperative anxiety and pain: systematic review & meta-analysis
The Efficiency of Binaural Beats on Anxiety and Depression — A Systematic Review

headline: Study-session boost (adult ADHD)
blurb: A short binaural track trialed with adult ADHD students. Improves how focused you feel — objective attention gains are less clear.
label: 15 Hz beta — adult ADHD study support (subjective)

citations.title: Pilot RCT: binaural beats on study performance and mind-wandering in adult ADHD
Alpha, Beta, and Gamma Binaural Beat Brain Stimulation on Working Memory: within-subject RCT
Potential of binaural beats for improving memory and attention: meta-analysis & systematic review

notes: 8 min. Adult ADHD RCT improved subjective study performance only - objective attention measures were unchanged. Requires headphones.

headline: Focus for inattentive minds (ADHD)
blurb: Steady white noise studied in children and adults with inattention. Plays quietly in the background while you work.
label: White noise — ADHD / inattention (stochastic resonance)

citations.title: Listen to the noise: noise is beneficial for cognitive performance in ADHD
citations.journal: Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry

citations.title: Auditory white noise benefits memory recall in children with attention problems
White noise improves learning by modulating activity in dopaminergic midbrain regions

notes: Background listening at low volume, 20-30 min. Effect is strongest for people with attention deficits (stochastic resonance hypothesis); may mildly hurt focus in low-ADHD listeners.

headline: Fibromyalgia pain relief (hardware only)
blurb: A 40 Hz vibration delivered through a chair or bed — not through headphones. We can't play this here; the studies are for your reference.
label: 40 Hz vibroacoustic (fibromyalgia)

citations.title: Vibroacoustic treatment for fibromyalgia: a pilot study
Exploring vibroacoustic therapy in adults experiencing pain: a scoping review

notes: Validated via tactile vibration through the torso, not audio. Headphone playback is NOT equivalent and will not replicate the effect. Requires a vibroacoustic chair/bed/mat.
